page_title: MNT 2-2 NIC | Montpellier v Nice 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' Evann Guessand (Nice) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
90+4' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+3' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
90+2' The referee awards a corner and Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take it.
90+1' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
90' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
89' One of the Nice players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
88' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Marcin Bulka.
87' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
87' Rares Ilie (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
85' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Sofiane Diop will be replaced by Rares Ilie (Nice).
85' A substitution has been made. Tanguy Ndombele goes off and Issiaga Camara (Nice) comes on.
84' The corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is intercepted by the defence.
82' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared by the defence.
80' 2 - 2 Goal! Mousa Al-Tamari tees up Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:2.
79' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends the corner into the box, but Marcin Bulka intercepts it and averts the threat.
77' Dangerous play by Yael Nandjou (Nice). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
75' A substitution has been made. Akor Adams is replaced by Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier).
74' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Issiaga Sylla and he is replaced by Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier).
73' The corner from Sofiane Diop (Nice) is hurriedly cleared.
72' The game is interrupted. Evann Guessand (Nice) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
71' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Tom Louchet (Nice) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Yael Nandjou.
71' The foul by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
69' The game is interrupted now, Tom Louchet (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
69' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
68' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) gets inside the box and tries to beat Marcin Bulka with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
64' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) brings his opponent down. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Akor Adams (Montpellier) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Substitution. Jonathan Clauss is replaced by Melvin Bard (Nice).
62' Substitution. Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) has come on for Enzo Tchato.
61' Here is a change. Arnaud Nordin is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier).
61' Substitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) on for Jordan Ferri.
56' A pass from Joris Chotard (Montpellier) is intercepted by Marcin Bulka and the move breaks down.
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
54' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' Close! Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
51' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier). Clement Turpin saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
50' A snap shot by Akor Adams (Montpellier) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Marcin Bulka produces a good save to thwart him.
47' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.

46' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Benjamin Lecomte leaps like a salmon to deny him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
44' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Marcin Bulka makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
43' Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
42' Evann Guessand (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
40' It's a nice effort by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Marcin Bulka. Easy save.
39' Evann Guessand (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Sofiane Diop (Nice) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
37' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
36' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the right side of the target, but Benjamin Lecomte keeps it out with an amazing save.
34' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
34' Evann Guessand (Nice) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
32' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
31' Poor challenge! Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is penalised for tripping and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
30' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

28' 1 - 2 Goal! Badredine Bouanani (Nice) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Benjamin Lecomte had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
27' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.

25' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
24' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Moise Bombito (Nice).
22' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Joris Chotard (Montpellier) does well to meet a cross inside the box and powers a header past the helpless goalkeeper.
22' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
19' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
19' A pass from Evann Guessand (Nice) is intercepted by Benjamin Lecomte and the move breaks down.
17' 0 - 1 Gaetan Laborde (Nice) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.

17' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Clement Turpin with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a comfortable save.
15' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) serves up a nice cross, but Marcin Bulka punches the ball away.
15' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
14' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' A pass into the penalty area from Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) is intercepted by the defence.
13' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
12' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sofiane Diop (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' A cross into the box from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared.
9' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Enzo Tchato (Montpellier).
7' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
6' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Teji Savanier (Montpellier) heads on.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Montpellier will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Clement Turpin.
